modules.purpose: Timed signing model proofs: signing-time monotonicity along parent-linked chains (from TimedExecution.chain_order + id_inj), the 'one real slot, one chain block' lemma, and the counting lemmas (belowCount / windows / Byzantine budget over Ico) that Results.lean assembles into forged_suffix_time_bound / forged_chain_time_bound. Namespace MoltPetit.Model. Contains ONE definition (belowCount); the model structures (TimedLog, TimedExecution, AvailableAt, SignedEver) live in Definitions.lean.
imports: MoltPetit.Model.Grounded (transitively: MoltPetit.TS.Bridge, MoltPetit.Model.Liveness, Soundness, Safety, Model, KeyIndex, Definitions, Mathlib, MoltPetit.TS.Emitted)

defs.name: belowCount
defs.signature: def belowCount (c : Chain) (k : Nat) : Nat := (c.filter fun B => decide (B.slot < k)).length
defs.meaning: Number of chain blocks whose stamp is strictly below k.

theorems.name: block_signed
hypotheses: {R : Nat} (hAvail : ∀ B ∈ c, AvailableAt log G B R)
{B : Block} (hB : blockAt? c k = some B)
theorems.conclusion: B ≠ G ∧ ∃ r, r ≤ R ∧ B ∈ log r
theorems.notes: Needs NO TimedExecution. Index k ≥ 1 is essential: index 0 has prev = none by ParentLinked; blocks at index ≥ 1 have prev = some _, hence ≠ G. Does not require c[0] = G.

theorems.name: sigTime_mono_step
hypotheses: {n : Nat} {bad : ByzantineSlots} {log : TimedLog} {G : Block} (hexec : TimedExecution n bad log G)
theorems.conclusion: Nat.find hPsig ≤ Nat.find hBsig
theorems.notes: Uses hexec.chain_order and hexec.id_inj only. First-signing time is Nat.find over ∃ r, B ∈ log r (needs DecidablePred — classical instance available since Finset membership on Block with DecidableEq).

theorems.name: sigTime_mono_chain
hypotheses: {R : Nat} (hAvail : ∀ B ∈ c, AvailableAt log G B R)
∀ {B B' : Block}, blockAt? c k = some B → blockAt? c (k + d) = some B' →
∀ (hBsig : ∃ r, B ∈ log r) (hB'sig : ∃ r, B' ∈ log r)
theorems.conclusion: Nat.find hBsig ≤ Nat.find hB'sig
theorems.notes: Induction on the index gap d; uses block_signed + sigTime_mono_step. Only needs ParentLinked (not full ValidChain).

theorems.name: one_real_slot_one_block
hypotheses: {bad : ByzantineSlots} {log : TimedLog} {G : Block} (hexec : TimedExecution n bad log G)
{R : Nat} (hAvail : ∀ B ∈ c, AvailableAt log G B R)
{B B' : Block} (hB : blockAt? c k = some B) (hB' : blockAt? c k' = some B')
{r : Nat} (hBr : B ∈ log r) (hBmin : ∀ r' < r, B ∉ log r')
(hB'r : B' ∈ log r) (hB'min : ∀ r' < r, B' ∉ log r')
theorems.conclusion: False
theorems.notes: Two distinct chain blocks (indices ≥ 1) cannot both be FIRST-signed at the same real slot r. Uses hexec.key_match, MaturedWindowsDense at B' for window [B.slot+1, B.slot+1+n), 2 ≤ quorum n (from hn), StrictSlots, sigTime_mono_chain. The 'first-signed' minimality hypotheses are stated as ∀ r' < r, B ∉ log r' (not via Nat.find).

theorems.name: belowCount_le
theorems.conclusion: belowCount c k ≤ c.length

theorems.name: belowCount_cons
theorems.conclusion: belowCount (b :: rest) k = (if b.slot < k then 1 else 0) + belowCount rest k

theorems.name: belowCount_split
theorems.conclusion: belowCount c (u + len) = belowCount c u + windowCount c u len
theorems.notes: Uses windowCount_cons from MoltPetit/TS/Bridge.lean:134.

theorems.name: belowCount_zero
theorems.conclusion: belowCount c 0 = 0

theorems.name: belowCount_windows
hypotheses: ∀ m, (∀ j < m, q ≤ windowCount c (lo + j * n) n)
theorems.conclusion: belowCount c lo + q * m ≤ belowCount c (lo + m * n)
theorems.notes: Density of m consecutive n-windows starting at lo forces q·m blocks in [lo, lo + m·n). Windows must be aligned at lo + j*n.

theorems.name: belowCount_prefix
hypotheses: {k₀ : Nat} {F : Block} (blockAt? c k₀ = some F)
theorems.conclusion: k₀ + 1 ≤ belowCount c (F.slot + 1)

theorems.name: bad_budget_Ico
theorems.conclusion: ((Finset.Ico r₀ (r₀ + k * n)).filter fun s => bad s).card ≤ maxByzantine n * k
theorems.notes: Declared under `open Classical in`. The filter predicate is the Prop `bad s`; matches badSlotsIn unfolded.

modules.purpose: Derives the recency-scoped unforgeability assumption SigUnforgeableRecent (consumed by light-client safety) from TimedExecution + a new residue NoBackdate, via the projected stamped log projectSigned; and proves NoBackdate is independent of the five TimedExecution fields by an explicit n = 2 counter-execution. Namespace MoltPetit.Model.

defs.name: projectSigned
defs.signature: noncomputable def projectSigned (n : Nat) (log : TimedLog) : SigningLog := fun p s => if h : p = producerForSlot n s ∧ ∃ B, B ∈ log s ∧ B.slot = s then some h.2.choose else none
defs.meaning: Stamped signing log read off a real-time log: participant p's entry at stamped slot s is (a choice of) the block stamped s that was signed AT real slot s, provided p is s's producer; canonical only at honest real slots (honest_once).

defs.name: NoBackdate
defs.signature: def NoBackdate (bad : ByzantineSlots) (log : TimedLog) : Prop := ∀ ⦃r : Nat⦄ ⦃B : Block⦄, B ∈ log r → ¬ bad B.slot → B.slot = r
defs.meaning: No back-dating onto an honest stamp: a block whose STAMP is honest was signed at the real slot equal to its stamp (forward-secure / stamp-bound custody residue). Note `bad` is applied to the stamp B.slot, whereas TimedExecution applies `bad` to the real slot r.

theorems.name: sigUnforgeableRecent_of_timed
hypotheses: {n : Nat} {bad : ByzantineSlots} {log : TimedLog} {G : Block} {Signed : Block → Prop} {now Δ : Nat}
(hbridge : ∀ ⦃B : Block⦄, Signed B → ∃ r, B ∈ log r)
theorems.conclusion: SigUnforgeableRecent n bad Signed (projectSigned n log) now Δ
theorems.notes: now and Δ are arbitrary; the recency hypothesis inside SigUnforgeableRecent.verified_was_signed and the ValidChain/membership hypotheses are discarded (`intro B c _hVC _hBc _hrec hbadB hSB`). Uses only hexec.honest_once besides NoBackdate. The SigningLog produced is specifically projectSigned n log — to feed a safety theorem quantified over an abstract `signed : SigningLog`, instantiate signed := projectSigned n log.

theorems.name: noBackdate_independent
theorems.conclusion: ∃ (bad : ByzantineSlots) (log : TimedLog) (G : Block), TimedExecution 2 bad log G ∧ ¬ NoBackdate bad log
theorems.notes: Witness: bad := fun r => r = 3; log := fun r => if r = 3 then {⟨1, 1, some 100, 101, 0, 0⟩} else ∅; G := ⟨0, 0, none, 100, 0, 0⟩ (Block fields in order slot, height, prev, id, contentsHash, keyIndex). All five fields discharged via `refine { key_match := ?_, honest_stamp := ?_, honest_once := ?_, chain_order := ?_, id_inj := ?_ }`.

modules.purpose: Liveness: (local) the honest one-block extension of a validator-accepted chain is again accepted, given the Byzantine budget and honest-block delivery (HonestBlocksCover) for newly matured windows; (global) a synchronous honest run buildChain g ss validates and has ss.length + 1 blocks. Namespace MoltPetit.Model. The produceBlock?-level corollaries (liveness_produce_block, liveness_produce_signed_block) are NOT here despite the module docstring — they are in MoltPetit/Results/Results.lean.

defs.name: buildFrom
defs.signature: def buildFrom (tip : Block) : List Nat → Chain | [] => [] | s :: ss => nextBlock s s 0 0 tip :: buildFrom (nextBlock s s 0 0 tip) ss
defs.meaning: Extend tip by one honest block per schedule slot, each built on the previous; block id := its slot, contentsHash := 0, keyIndex := 0.

defs.name: buildChain
defs.signature: def buildChain (g : Block) (ss : List Nat) : Chain := g :: buildFrom g ss
defs.meaning: A synchronous honest run from genesis g over honest schedule ss: a single linear chain, no forks, no adversarial blocks, no signatures, no record.

theorems.name: quorum_plus_byzantine_le
theorems.conclusion: quorum n + maxByzantine n ≤ n

theorems.name: windowCount_mono
hypotheses: {u len : Nat} {c c' : Chain} (h : c.Sublist c')
theorems.conclusion: windowCount c u len ≤ windowCount c' u len

theorems.name: slot_le_tip_of_mem
theorems.conclusion: x.slot ≤ tip.slot

theorems.name: strictSlots_append_one
theorems.conclusion: StrictSlots (c ++ [b])

theorems.name: linksOk_append_one
hypotheses: (∃ tip : Block, c.getLast? = some tip ∧ childOk tip b = true)
theorems.conclusion: linksOk (c ++ [b]) = true

theorems.name: validChain_append_one
hypotheses: {n : Nat} {c : Chain} {b tip : Block} (hValid : validChain n c = true)
(hAllDense : ∀ u : Nat, u + n ≤ b.slot + 1 → windowDense n (c ++ [b]) u = true)
theorems.conclusion: validChain n (c ++ [b]) = true
theorems.notes: Purely structural; density for ALL windows matured at b (not just new ones) must be supplied.

theorems.name: window_dense_of_honest_cover_at
hypotheses: {n : Nat} {bad : ByzantineSlots} {record : SlotRecord} {c : Chain} (hS : StrictSlots c)
(hSCorrect : ∀ s (B : Block), B ∈ record s → B.slot = s)
{u : Nat} (hBudgetU : (badSlotsIn bad u n).card ≤ maxByzantine n)
(hCover : HonestBlocksCover bad record c u n)
theorems.conclusion: quorum n ≤ windowCount c u n
theorems.notes: Per-window form (budget only at this u). Uses chainSlotsIn_card, mem_chainSlotsIn (Model.lean), quorum_plus_byzantine_le, Finset.card_sdiff.

theorems.name: window_dense_of_honest_cover
hypotheses: (hSCorrect : ∀ s (B : Block), B ∈ record s → B.slot = s)
{u : Nat} (hCover : HonestBlocksCover bad record c u n)
theorems.conclusion: quorum n ≤ windowCount c u n

theorems.name: liveness_valid_extension
hypotheses: {n : Nat} {bad : ByzantineSlots} {record : SlotRecord} {c : Chain} {slot newId : Nat} {contentsHash keyIndex : Nat} {tip : Block}
(hSCorrect : ∀ s (B : Block), B ∈ record s → B.slot = s)
(hCover : ∀ u, tip.slot + 1 < u + n → u + n ≤ slot + 1 → HonestBlocksCover bad record (c ++ [nextBlock slot newId contentsHash keyIndex tip]) u n)
theorems.conclusion: validChain n (c ++ [nextBlock slot newId contentsHash keyIndex tip]) = true
theorems.notes: Liveness core. hCover is over the EXTENDED chain and only for windows newly matured at `slot` (old windows are dense by windowCount_mono). If `slot` itself is honest and lies in such a window, the cover demands some block of record slot inside c ++ [b], so the caller must have the new block (or another block at slot) in `record slot`. Uses validChain_sound (Soundness.lean) to obtain StrictSlots/MaturedWindowsDense from the Bool validator.

theorems.name: buildFrom_map_slot
theorems.conclusion: (buildFrom tip ss).map Block.slot = ss

theorems.name: buildFrom_length
theorems.conclusion: (buildFrom tip ss).length = ss.length

theorems.name: buildChain_length
theorems.conclusion: (buildChain g ss).length = ss.length + 1

theorems.name: buildChain_map_slot
theorems.conclusion: (buildChain g ss).map Block.slot = g.slot :: ss

theorems.name: linksOk_buildFrom
theorems.conclusion: linksOk (tip :: buildFrom tip ss) = true

theorems.name: strictSlots_buildChain
theorems.conclusion: StrictSlots (buildChain g ss)

theorems.name: liveness_global
hypotheses: (hBudget : ∀ u, u + n ≤ (g.slot :: ss).getLast (List.cons_ne_nil _ _) + 1 → (badSlotsIn (fun s => s ∉ g.slot :: ss) u n).card ≤ maxByzantine n)
theorems.conclusion: validChain n (buildChain g ss) = true ∧ (buildChain g ss).length = ss.length + 1
theorems.notes: SINGLE-CHAIN ASSUMPTION BAKED IN: the run IS buildChain g ss — one linear chain where every block is built on its immediate predecessor (delivery/synchrony by construction, 'no honest fork'); the adversary is DEFINED as bad := fun s => s ∉ g.slot :: ss (every unscheduled slot is Byzantine, including the genesis slot being scheduled); the budget is required only over windows maturing at the last scheduled slot; record is defined internally as the run's own blocks (record s := (buildChain g ss).filter (·.slot = s)).toFinset). No TimedExecution/log, no signatures, no produceBlock?/selectChain, no competing chains, no id hypothesis (ids are the slot numbers). Aliased as Molt.global_liveness (Molt/Liveness.lean:33).

modules.purpose: All definitions needed to state the main results, in one file: executable model (blocks, chains, density validator, signed chains, production, chain selection), certified chains, semantic predicates of the safety proof, the signing model, TS-bridge injections, GroundedCert and the two light-client assumptions, the real-time signing model TimedExecution, HonestBlocksCover, and the ProverTiming defs. Namespace MoltPetit.Model (sub-namespace ProverTiming). No theorems. NOTE: validChainK, denseSoFar, faultBudget (named in the brief as if here) are NOT in this file — see Model/KeyIndex.lean:71, Molt/Protocol.lean:88, Molt/Protocol.lean:27.
imports: MoltPetit.TS.Emitted (namespace MoltPetit: the thales-emitted TS sidecar; provides MoltPetit.Chain, MoltPetit.CertClaim, MoltPetit.SignedChain, MoltPetit.SigOps, MoltPetit.RawSignature, MoltPetit.validChainK (Int) etc.)

defs.name: quorum
defs.signature: def quorum (n : Nat) : Nat := (2 * n + 2) / 3
defs.meaning: Density threshold ⌈2n/3⌉.

defs.name: maxByzantine
defs.signature: def maxByzantine (n : Nat) : Nat := (n - 1) / 3
defs.meaning: Max tolerated Byzantine slots per n-window ⌊(n-1)/3⌋ (Molt name: faultBudget).

defs.name: producerForSlot
defs.signature: def producerForSlot (n slot : Nat) : Nat := slot % n
defs.meaning: Round-robin producer index of a slot (Molt name: producer).

defs.name: Block
defs.signature: structure Block where slot : Nat; height : Nat; prev : Option Nat; id : Nat; contentsHash : Nat; keyIndex : Nat  deriving Repr, DecidableEq
defs.meaning: A block; id abstracts a collision-resistant hash supplied by the caller; keyIndex is the in-band delegate-key version the producer signed under. Anonymous-constructor field order: ⟨slot, height, prev, id, contentsHash, keyIndex⟩.

defs.name: Chain
defs.signature: abbrev Chain := List Block
defs.meaning: Linear history, lowest height first.

defs.name: blockInWindow
defs.signature: def blockInWindow (u len : Nat) (b : Block) : Bool := decide (u ≤ b.slot ∧ b.slot < u + len)
defs.meaning: b's slot lies in [u, u+len).

defs.name: windowCount
defs.signature: def windowCount (c : Chain) (u len : Nat) : Nat := (c.filter (blockInWindow u len)).length
defs.meaning: Number of chain blocks with slot in [u, u+len).

defs.name: windowDense
defs.signature: def windowDense (n : Nat) (c : Chain) (u : Nat) : Bool := decide (quorum n ≤ windowCount c u n)
defs.meaning: One window meets quorum density.

defs.name: maturedWindowsDense
defs.signature: def maturedWindowsDense (n : Nat) (c : Chain) (t : Nat) : Bool := (List.range (t + 2 - n)).all fun u => windowDense n c u
defs.meaning: All windows matured at tip slot t (u + n ≤ t + 1, i.e. u ∈ range (t+2-n)) are dense (Molt name: denseSoFar).

defs.name: genesisOk
defs.signature: def genesisOk (b : Block) : Bool := decide (b.height = 0 ∧ b.prev = none)
defs.meaning: Structural genesis check (does NOT require slot = 0).

defs.name: childOk
defs.signature: def childOk (parent child : Block) : Bool := decide (child.height = parent.height + 1 ∧ parent.slot < child.slot ∧ child.prev = some parent.id)
defs.meaning: Immediate-successor check.

defs.name: linksOk
defs.signature: def linksOk : Chain → Bool | [] => true | [_] => true | a :: b :: rest => childOk a b && linksOk (b :: rest)
defs.meaning: Every adjacent pair satisfies childOk.

defs.name: validChain
defs.signature: def validChain (n : Nat) (c : Chain) : Bool := match c with | [] => true | g :: rest => genesisOk g && linksOk (g :: rest) && (match (g :: rest).getLast? with | some tip => maturedWindowsDense n (g :: rest) tip.slot | none => true)
defs.meaning: The executable validator replayed from genesis; [] is accepted.

defs.name: tipHeight
defs.signature: def tipHeight (c : Chain) : Option Nat := c.getLast?.map Block.height
defs.meaning: Height of the tip if any.

defs.name: selectChain
defs.signature: def selectChain (n : Nat) (cur candidate : Chain) : Chain := if validChain n candidate && candidate.length > cur.length then candidate else cur
defs.meaning: Longest-valid-chain adoption rule. No theorem anywhere in the repo is stated about it (only the definition, its @[export] wrapper, and Molt.selectChain which is the CERTIFIED-chain variant selectCertifiedChain).

defs.name: nextBlock
defs.signature: def nextBlock (slot newId : Nat) (contentsHash keyIndex : Nat) (tip : Block) : Block := { slot, height := tip.height + 1, prev := some tip.id, id := newId, contentsHash, keyIndex }
defs.meaning: The candidate child of tip.

defs.name: produceBlock?
defs.signature: def produceBlock? (n me slot newId : Nat) (contentsHash keyIndex : Nat) (c : Chain) : Option Block := if producerForSlot n slot = me then match c.getLast? with | none => none | some tip => if validChain n (c ++ [nextBlock slot newId contentsHash keyIndex tip]) then some (nextBlock slot newId contentsHash keyIndex tip) else none else none
defs.meaning: Honest production: only in own slot, only if the extension validates.

defs.name: genesisBlock
defs.signature: def genesisBlock (id : Nat) : Block := { slot := 0, height := 0, prev := none, id, contentsHash := 0, keyIndex := 0 }
defs.meaning: Fresh-deployment genesis.

defs.name: SigOps
defs.signature: structure SigOps (σ sk pk : Type) where sign : sk → Block → σ; verify : pk → Block → σ → Bool
defs.meaning: Abstract signature scheme over the Block content (signature not part of message).

defs.name: KeyRegistry
defs.signature: abbrev KeyRegistry (pk : Type) := Nat → Nat → pk
defs.meaning: Versioned public-key directory: registry i j = participant i's delegate key at index j.

defs.name: SignedBlock
defs.signature: structure SignedBlock (σ : Type) where block : Block; sig : σ  deriving Repr
defs.meaning: Wire block: content + detached signature.

defs.name: SignedChain
defs.signature: abbrev SignedChain (σ : Type) := List (SignedBlock σ)
defs.meaning: Signed chain.

defs.name: stripSigs
defs.signature: def stripSigs {σ : Type} (sc : SignedChain σ) : Chain := sc.map SignedBlock.block
defs.meaning: Drop signatures.

defs.name: sigOk
defs.signature: def sigOk {σ sk pk : Type} (n : Nat) (ops : SigOps σ sk pk) (registry : KeyRegistry pk) (sb : SignedBlock σ) : Bool := ops.verify (registry (producerForSlot n sb.block.slot) sb.block.keyIndex) sb.block sb.sig
defs.meaning: Per-block verification under the key selected by the block's producer AND its DECLARED in-band keyIndex.

defs.name: sigsOk
defs.signature: def sigsOk {σ sk pk : Type} (n : Nat) (ops : SigOps σ sk pk) (registry : KeyRegistry pk) (sc : SignedChain σ) : Bool := sc.all (sigOk n ops registry)
defs.meaning: All signatures verify.

defs.name: validSignedChain
defs.signature: def validSignedChain {σ sk pk : Type} (n : Nat) (ops : SigOps σ sk pk) (registry : KeyRegistry pk) (sc : SignedChain σ) : Bool := sigsOk n ops registry sc && validChain n (stripSigs sc)
defs.meaning: Signature check then structural validation.

defs.name: produceSignedBlock?
defs.signature: def produceSignedBlock? {σ sk pk : Type} (n me slot newId : Nat) (contentsHash keyIndex : Nat) (ops : SigOps σ sk pk) (registry : KeyRegistry pk) (myKey : sk) (sc : SignedChain σ) : Option (SignedBlock σ)
defs.meaning: Sign nextBlock with myKey, return it iff producerForSlot n slot = me and validSignedChain (sc ++ [sb]) (uses (stripSigs sc).getLast? as tip).

defs.name: selectSignedChain
defs.signature: def selectSignedChain {σ sk pk : Type} (n : Nat) (ops : SigOps σ sk pk) (registry : KeyRegistry pk) (cur candidate : SignedChain σ) : SignedChain σ
defs.meaning: Adopt candidate iff validSignedChain and strictly longer.

defs.name: trivialSigOps / trivialRegistry / signedGenesisBlock
defs.signature: def trivialSigOps : SigOps Unit Unit Unit; def trivialRegistry (_n : Nat) : KeyRegistry Unit; def signedGenesisBlock (id : Nat) : SignedBlock Unit
defs.meaning: Accept-everything signature instance for tests (lines 282, 288, 292).

defs.name: validChainExport / produceBlockExport / selectChainExport
defs.signature: @[export mcv2_valid_chain] def validChainExport (n : Nat) (c : Chain) : Bool; @[export mcv2_produce_block] def produceBlockExport ...; @[export mcv2_select_chain] def selectChainExport (n : Nat) (cur candidate : Chain) : Chain
defs.meaning: C entry points (lines 300, 303, 307).

defs.name: CertClaim
defs.signature: structure CertClaim where tipId : Nat; tipSlot : Nat; tipHeight : Nat; tail : List Block  deriving Repr, DecidableEq
defs.meaning: What a certificate claims: tip triple plus the boundary buffer of stripped prefix blocks near the tip.

defs.name: CertOps
defs.signature: structure CertOps (α : Type) where claim : α → CertClaim; verify : α → Bool; generate : α → Block → α
defs.meaning: Abstract certificate operations.

defs.name: CertifiedChain
defs.signature: structure CertifiedChain (α σ : Type) where cert : α; suffix : SignedChain σ  deriving Repr
defs.meaning: Certificate for the prefix plus a signed suffix.

defs.name: certTipHeight / certTipSlot / certTipId
defs.signature: def certTipHeight {α σ : Type} (ops : CertOps α) (cc : CertifiedChain α σ) : Nat := cc.suffix.getLast?.map (·.block.height) |>.getD (ops.claim cc.cert).tipHeight (similarly certTipSlot line 349, certTipId line 353)
defs.meaning: Effective tip of a certified chain (suffix tip else claim).

defs.name: validateSuffix
defs.signature: def validateSuffix {α σ sk pk : Type} (n : Nat) (sigOps : SigOps σ sk pk) (registry : KeyRegistry pk) (certOps : CertOps α) (cert : α) (suffix : SignedChain σ) : Bool
defs.meaning: sigsOk on suffix && link from claim tip to first suffix block && linksOk && density of windows in [tipSlot+2-n, t.slot+2-n) counted over claim.tail ++ suffix.

defs.name: validateCertifiedChain
defs.signature: def validateCertifiedChain {α σ sk pk : Type} (n : Nat) (sigOps : SigOps σ sk pk) (registry : KeyRegistry pk) (certOps : CertOps α) (cc : CertifiedChain α σ) : Bool := certOps.verify cc.cert && validateSuffix n sigOps registry certOps cc.cert cc.suffix
defs.meaning: Full certified-chain validation.

defs.name: produceBlockCert?
defs.signature: def produceBlockCert? {α σ sk pk : Type} (n me slot newId : Nat) (contentsHash keyIndex : Nat) (sigOps : SigOps σ sk pk) (registry : KeyRegistry pk) (myKey : sk) (certOps : CertOps α) (cc : CertifiedChain α σ) : Option (SignedBlock σ × CertifiedChain α σ)
defs.meaning: Certified production; tip defaults to a synthetic block from the claim (prev := none, contentsHash 0, keyIndex 0) when the suffix is empty.

defs.name: selectCertifiedChain
defs.signature: def selectCertifiedChain {α σ sk pk : Type} (n : Nat) (sigOps : SigOps σ sk pk) (registry : KeyRegistry pk) (certOps : CertOps α) (current candidate : CertifiedChain α σ) : CertifiedChain α σ
defs.meaning: Adopt candidate iff validateCertifiedChain and certTipHeight strictly higher (this is what Molt.selectChain bridges to).

defs.name: TrivialCert / trivialCertOps / trivialGenesisCertChain
defs.signature: abbrev TrivialCert := Chain; def trivialCertOps (n : Nat) : CertOps TrivialCert (claim: tip triple + tail := c.filter (tipSlot + 2 - n ≤ ·.slot); verify := validChain n; generate := (· ++ [·])); def trivialGenesisCertChain (genesisId : Nat) : CertifiedChain TrivialCert Unit
defs.meaning: Trivial certificate = the full stripped prefix (lines 431, 434, 446).

defs.name: SlotRecord
defs.signature: abbrev SlotRecord := Nat → Finset Block
defs.meaning: Blocks produced in each slot over the whole execution.

defs.name: ByzantineSlots
defs.signature: abbrev ByzantineSlots := Nat → Prop
defs.meaning: Adversary schedule; bad s = adversary owns slot s (Prop, so Finset filters need Classical).

defs.name: blockAt?
defs.signature: def blockAt? (c : Chain) (h : Nat) : Option Block := getElem? c h
defs.meaning: Block at list index h (unfold to getElem? then use List.getElem?_eq_some_iff / List.mem_of_getElem?).

defs.name: SequentialHeights
defs.signature: def SequentialHeights (c : Chain) : Prop := ∀ ⦃h⦄ ⦃B : Block⦄, blockAt? c h = some B → B.height = h
defs.meaning: Index = height.

defs.name: StrictSlots
defs.signature: def StrictSlots (c : Chain) : Prop := c.Pairwise fun a b => a.slot < b.slot
defs.meaning: Slots strictly increase.

defs.name: ParentLinked
defs.signature: def ParentLinked (c : Chain) : Prop := ∀ ⦃h⦄ ⦃B : Block⦄, blockAt? c h = some B → match h with | 0 => B.prev = none | k + 1 => ∃ P : Block, blockAt? c k = some P ∧ B.prev = some P.id
defs.meaning: Index 0 has no parent; every later block points at its predecessor's id.

defs.name: MaturedWindowsDense

defs.name: GroundedCert
defs.signature: inductive GroundedCert (n : Nat) (Signed : Block → Prop) (G : Block) : CertClaim → Prop | genesis : genesisOk G = true → G.slot = 0 → GroundedCert n Signed G { tipId := G.id, tipSlot := G.slot, tipHeight := G.height, tail := [G].filter fun x => decide (G.slot + 2 - n ≤ x.slot) } | extend (cl : CertClaim) (b : Block) : GroundedCert n Signed G cl → b.height = cl.tipHeight + 1 → cl.tipSlot < b.slot → b.prev = some cl.tipId → Signed b → (∀ u : Nat, cl.tipSlot + 2 ≤ u + n → u + n ≤ b.slot + 1 → quorum n ≤ windowCount (cl.tail ++ [b]) u n) → GroundedCert n Signed G { tipId := b.id, tipSlot := b.slot, tipHeight := b.height, tail := (cl.tail ++ [b]).filter fun x => decide (b.slot + 2 - n ≤ x.slot) }

defs.name: TimedLog

defs.meaning: What was signed at each REAL slot r (under r's producer's key).

defs.name: SignedEver
defs.signature: def SignedEver (log : TimedLog) (G : Block) (B : Block) : Prop := B = G ∨ ∃ r, B ∈ log r
defs.meaning: Domain of id injectivity in the timed model.

defs.name: AvailableAt
defs.signature: def AvailableAt (log : TimedLog) (G : Block) (B : Block) (R : Nat) : Prop := B = G ∨ ∃ r ≤ R, B ∈ log r
defs.meaning: B exists by real slot R.

defs.name: TimedExecution
defs.signature:
structure TimedExecution (n : Nat) (bad : ByzantineSlots) (log : TimedLog) (G : Block) : Prop where
  key_match : ∀ ⦃r : Nat⦄ ⦃B : Block⦄, B ∈ log r → B.slot % n = r % n
  honest_stamp : ∀ ⦃r : Nat⦄, ¬ bad r → ∀ ⦃B : Block⦄, B ∈ log r → B.slot = r
  honest_once : ∀ ⦃r : Nat⦄, ¬ bad r → ∀ ⦃B B' : Block⦄, B ∈ log r → B' ∈ log r → B = B'
  chain_order : ∀ ⦃r : Nat⦄ ⦃B : Block⦄, B ∈ log r → ∀ ⦃i : Nat⦄, B.prev = some i → ∃ P : Block, P.id = i ∧ AvailableAt log G P r
  id_inj : ∀ ⦃B B' : Block⦄, SignedEver log G B → SignedEver log G B' → B.id = B'.id → B = B'
defs.meaning: Real-time signing model, ALL FIVE FIELDS: key_match (stamp ≡ real slot mod n), honest_stamp (honest real slot signs only its own stamp), honest_once (honest real slot signs ≤ 1 block), chain_order (a signed block's parent — some block with the referenced id — is available at or before the signing real slot; residue of id = H(..., parentSig, ...)), id_inj (collision resistance over genesis ∪ ever-signed). `bad` here is over REAL slots r. Corruption is per real slot; a bad real slot may sign any stamp in its residue class.

defs.name: HonestBlocksCover
defs.signature: def HonestBlocksCover (bad : ByzantineSlots) (record : SlotRecord) (c : Chain) (u n : Nat) : Prop := ∀ s, ¬ bad s → u ≤ s → s < u + n → ∃ B : Block, B ∈ record s ∧ B ∈ c
defs.meaning: Honest-block delivery for window [u, u+n): every honest slot has a recorded block already in c (liveness/synchrony packaging).

Molt side: Molt.Protocol ← Molt.Verifier ← Molt.Assumptions ← Molt.Results (also imports MoltPetit.Results.Results + MoltPetit.Model.TimedSig) ← Molt.Rotation ← Molt.Liveness (also imports KeyRotationLiveness). So: a new core module wanting TimedExecution + liveness + forged bounds + NoBackdate should `import MoltPetit.Results.Results` and `import MoltPetit.Model.TimedSig`; a new Molt-side module should `import Molt.Results` (and `Molt.Liveness`/`Molt.Rotation` if it needs validChainK/global_liveness names).

BUILD REGISTRATION GOTCHA: lakefile.toml declares the four lean_libs (MoltPetit, Rust, Thales, Molt) with NO `globs`, so the default `lake build` only compiles modules reachable from the root import lists in MoltPetit.lean / Molt.lean. A purely additive file (no edits to existing files) must be built explicitly, e.g. `lake build MoltPetit.Model.<New>` or `lake build Molt.<New>`, and it will not be covered by the existing axiom audit (MoltPetit/Results/Axioms.lean uses `#guard_msgs in #print axioms` per headline theorem) — replicate that guard locally in the new file if axiom hygiene matters. Toolchain: leanprover/lean4:v4.30.0-rc2, Mathlib v4.30.0-rc2, `relaxedAutoImplicit = false` (bind every variable), mathlib standard linter set on.

NAMESPACE/IDIOMS: core proofs live in `namespace MoltPetit.Model` (sub-namespace ProverTiming); paper-facing re-presentations in `namespace Molt`. Molt idiom: shared TYPES are `abbrev` (Block, Chain, SigOps, TimedLog, TimedExecution, NoBackdate, SigUnforgeableRecent via `@`), simple computable/Prop defs are re-declared verbatim and bridged by `theorem foo_eq_core : foo = MoltPetit.Model.foo := rfl`, recursive/matching defs are bridged by funext+induction/simp (linksOk, validChain, validSignedChain, validSuffix, validCertifiedChain, produceBlock?, selectChain, validChainK, validChainK', validSignedChainK') and must be `rw [..._eq_core] at h` before feeding hypotheses to a core theorem; theorems are either `alias X := MoltPetit.Model.X` or restated with paper names (FaultBounded, faultBudget, producer, rNow) and proved by applying the core theorem verbatim (definitional unfolding covers rfl bridges). Prop-structures (TimedExecution, SigUnforgeableRecent, SigCorrect) are built with `refine { key_match := ?_, honest_stamp := ?_, honest_once := ?_, chain_order := ?_, id_inj := ?_ }` or `constructor`. Finset filters over `bad : Nat → Prop` need `open Classical in` (badSlotsIn, bad_budget_Ico, projectSigned, forged_* theorems). First-signing time is `Nat.find (h : ∃ r, B ∈ log r)` with `Nat.find_eq_iff`, `Nat.find_spec`, `Nat.find_min'`, and theorems phrase minimality as `∀ r' < r, B ∉ log r'`. `blockAt?` is `getElem?`: unfold then `List.getElem?_eq_some_iff`, `List.getElem?_eq_getElem`, `List.mem_of_getElem?`; `ValidChain` destructures as ⟨hSeq, hS, hPL, hMat⟩; go Bool→semantic with `validChain_sound`; tip index via `blockAt_getLast`; index→slot order via `strictSlots_lt`; membership→index via `exists_blockAt_of_mem`.

GENESIS / INDEX-0 GOTCHAS: block_signed, sigTime_mono_chain, one_real_slot_one_block, forged_suffix_time_bound all require the index k (or k₀) ≥ 1 and `hGprev : G.prev = none`; they do NOT require c[0] = G, only ParentLinked (so c[0].prev = none) — hence any block at index ≥ 1 is ≠ G and is in the log by hAvail. hAvail must cover every block of c including index 0 (satisfied via the `B = G` disjunct or a log entry). GroundedCert.genesis additionally demands `G.slot = 0` and `genesisOk G`; liveness_global demands `genesisOk g` but not g.slot = 0 (g.slot is whatever heads the schedule). validChain accepts [] and does not check slot 0.

BAD-SLOT READINGS (real vs stamped): TimedExecution applies `bad` to REAL slots r (honest_stamp/honest_once, and hForged in the forged bounds quantify `bad r` over signing slots); NoBackdate, SigUnforgeableRecent.verified_was_signed, HonestBlocksCover, HonestSlotsUnique apply `bad` to the STAMP B.slot / record slot s; ByzantineBounded n bad is one budget used for both readings. They coincide only under NoBackdate/honest_stamp. A new module mixing timed and stamped statements must pick one `bad` and prove the crossover explicitly.

BUDGET/DENSITY READ-OFF: forged_suffix_time_bound / forged_chain_time_bound read density from the chain c's own MaturedWindowsDense at its tip (windows aligned at F.slot+1 + j*n resp. 0 + j*n via belowCount_windows) and the budget from ByzantineBounded on real slots (bad_budget_Ico over Ico r₀ (R+1) resp. Ico 0 (R+1)); both need hn : 2 ≤ n; the lag corollaries additionally need 1 ≤ maxByzantine n (i.e. n ≥ 4). Molt.forged_time_bound is the SUFFIX bound (paper Theorem 2); Molt.forged_chain_time_bound is the alias of the from-genesis bound.

SIGNED PREDICATE, DECLARED vs REGISTERED: sigUnforgeableRecent_of_timed takes an abstract `Signed : Block → Prop` plus the EUF-CMA bridge `hbridge : Signed B → ∃ r, B ∈ log r` (this bridge is the only place the crypto enters; nothing in the repo proves it for TSSigned). TSSigned / sigOk / SigCorrect all verify under the block's DECLARED in-band keyIndex (`keyFor (producerForSlot n B.slot) B.keyIndex`), not the version in force; the in-force check is validChainK'/inForcePinned (KeyRotation). The result of sigUnforgeableRecent_of_timed is for `signed := projectSigned n log` (noncomputable, Classical.choose; canonical only at honest real slots) and holds for every now and Δ — the recency scoping is slack there.

LIVENESS SINGLE-CHAIN ASSUMPTION: liveness_valid_extension / liveness_produce_block / liveness_produce_blockK all speak about ONE chain c the producer holds (c.getLast? = some tip, validChain n c = true as Bool) and demand HonestBlocksCover over the EXTENDED chain c ++ [nextBlock ...] for exactly the windows newly matured at `slot` (tip.slot + 1 < u + n ≤ slot + 1); if `slot` is honest and inside such a window the cover forces some `record slot` block to be in c ++ [b], i.e. the caller must register the new block in `record`; `hSCorrect : ∀ s B, B ∈ record s → B.slot = s` is a global record hypothesis. liveness_global hard-codes the single chain: the run IS buildChain g ss (each block built on its immediate predecessor; ids = slots, contentsHash = keyIndex = 0), `bad := fun s => s ∉ g.slot :: ss` (every unscheduled slot is adversarial by definition), budget only over windows maturing by the last scheduled slot, record := the run's own blocks. There is no theorem anywhere about MoltPetit.Model.selectChain (Molt.selectChain is selectCertifiedChain); no theorem connects liveness to TimedExecution/log, to competing chains, or to forks. A new module wanting multi-chain or network liveness must add its own model; the reusable pieces are validChain_append_one, window_dense_of_honest_cover(_at), windowCount_mono, strictSlots_append_one, linksOk_append_one, slot_le_tip_of_mem, quorum_plus_byzantine_le, and the buildChain lemmas.

ARITHMETIC FACTS proved inline (re-derive with `unfold quorum maxByzantine; omega`): quorum n + maxByzantine n ≤ n (theorem), 2 ≤ quorum n given 2 ≤ n, 2 * maxByzantine n + 1 ≤ quorum n.
